newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat firm, corn, soy steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat firm, corn, soy steady.

text.p: Nearby FOB soft red winter wheat offers were higher on Monday but activity was slow, export sources said.
"There's not a lot offered today but the river is quoted firm," a wheat broker said.

Corn and soybean values were steady in quiet conditions. Exporters noted attention was focused on Tuesday's USDA crop report. They said the trade expected an increase in corn and soybean production figures.
"Everybody is waiting on the USDA," a broker said. "It should show we've got more to ship out there."
Export sources were wary of a brewing trade dispute between the United States and China but said they did not expect much disruption.
They noted wheat exports to China had been virtually non-existent but soy complex demand had been strong.

"I really don't think this will change much," one broker said. "They need beans and meal and we're the only place to get it for now. They can talk all they want about not taking wheat and corn. They weren't really buying much anyway."
